marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure Momentum
marketLayer.fact: Major US chipmakers and server suppliers reported sustained double-digit revenue growth in AI hardware deployments, driving overnight gains across the Nasdaq and Philadelphia Semiconductor Index.
marketLayer.inference: Strengthening demand for next-generation AI accelerators provides tailwinds for global technology supply chains, encouraging capital inflows into HK-listed tech giants and semiconductor foundries.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential export restrictions and supply constraints on high-bandwidth memory (HBM) components.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: Recent US inflation and labor market data signaled stabilizing price pressures, prompting market pricing to reflect a high probability of monetary easing in upcoming FOMC meetings.
marketLayer.inference: A lower US rate environment relieves upward pressure on the US dollar, expanding valuation headroom for emerging market assets and boosting liquidity in the Hong Kong equity market.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Unexpected rebounds in service-sector inflation or sticky wage growth data.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Chinese Electric Vehicle (EV) Dynamic
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index fluctuated as major domestic EV makers unveiled new model upgrades alongside aggressive overseas export targets, while domestic price adjustments continued.
marketLayer.inference: Export gains may offset domestic margin pressures for leading EV players, but heightened competition in China's domestic market continues to cap short-term valuation multiples across auto components and retail stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Overseas trade policy developments and regional tariff adjustments targeting Chinese electric vehicles.
